en: I hope I get to work with Lady Geist. She's an icon!
It was either do this or go to a lame vampire salon, and let me tell you, I do not plan on putting up with 6 hours of harpsichord music.
The elders can keep the old world. New York is going to be my playground.
I'm tired of being at the bottom of the vampiric social ladder.
Time to shake up the vampiric hierarchy.
This city could use some new blood.
Summoning the Patrons never looked this good.
Soon, I'll be Viscount of New York.
I'm not hanging out with those losers.
I have a fashion empire to build.
I have a whole life to build after my parents botched my turning, so no, I'm not helping you right now. I'm a little busy.
Sorry, I'm working on my look-book.
I have better things to do with my time than help the Patrons.
If I die, I can't go to fashion week and I'm not risking that.
Can't, I'm busy sucking up to the viscount today.
I'm sure there's someone out there dumb enough to risk their life.
Go get Vyper to help you, she'll probably do it for a trip to the laundromat. You know, assuming she's not in jail.
Oh, I'm flattered, but I'm not interested in associating with some of those people.
I don't think we've met, I'm Abrams.
Of course we haven't met. I try not to talk to poor people.
Abrams, do whatever I tell you and we'll get along just fine.
Not your boss, just your better.
So you one of those vampires who looks young, but is actually 200 years old, or one of the vampires who's new to the party?
I have better things to do with my time.
I see people still have eyes. Heh.
We should talk. After the ritual, I'm going to be Viscount.
I met the Viscount once. Fascinating man.
Well, he's about to become obsolete.
Psh, who's going to replace him? You?
You have a problem with that?
You smell like garbage and motor oil.
I work in a scrap yard.
Miss Shelly says you shouldn't judge someone based on what they do.
Well Miss Shelly is probably poor, so of course she would say that.
Don't talk about my mother like that.
Do you like being a vampire?
Honestly it's kind of lame. Anytime there's a vampire salon, I have to hang out with a bunch of old people.
Can't you just skip the salon?
No no no, you don't skip a salon. Not showing up is seen as a snub, and the only thing worse than a boring old vampire, is an angry vampire.
So what do you do? Throw a boomerang?
Why would I throw a boomerang?
Cause you're like an Australian robot or whatever?
Ok. So 1, I was created in America. 2, I sound British, not Australian.
Why would she make you sound like that?
That's a question for her, not me

Alright Mina, here's the deal. On one hand, you're a stuck up bitch. On the other hand, your goal is to get rid of some old as dirt vampire elder. So as much as I hate rich assholes, which you are, I'm gonna help you because there's an older, richer asshole that needs to go.
Lady, I don't wanna be your friend.
Let me guess, mommy and daddy got you everything.
So what's it like being in the real world where you don't always get what you want?
I ain't takin' the bait, Mina.
Fashion week wasn't kind to you last year.
Mina, could you design me a dress?
I don't know, can you afford it?
I think I can mangage, yes.
I think we met at a Kelsey Evans party a few years ago.
That was the boat one, right?
I can't speak for the food, I only drink blood.
Right, well you weren't missing much, but nice to meet you again.
Your outfit was great at Ren Faire.
Oh you had this whole gothic masquerade thing going on--
How are you doing, Miss Ha?
I try not to talk to the help.
So, what do you plan on doing to help? Holding open a door while I do all the work?
You could’ve at least changed when you got off of work.
Ah, but this one’s freshly pressed.
When I'm Viscount, I'll lift The Venery on you.
Well that's mighty kind of you miss.
It's not kind, it's practical. You're just gonna ignore it anyway, and it would make me look weak.
You know who I am, right?
Everyone in the Barony of New York knows who you are.
Then why aren't you being a good little vampire and following Simon's orders?
Because if you're old enough to call The Viscount by his first name you're probably strong enough to tear me in half.
I got a funny story about that… I'll tell you later.
That doesn't make it any less heinous. After the ritual I'm getting you something tailored.
I dunno, it's not the same if I don't work for it.
If killing a bunch of people and summoning the patron isn't working for it I don't know what is.
Why do you care so much?
Because I want to say I made a bespoke jacket for a legend.
Miss, you've made a compelling argument.
Professor, if you're so smart, why are you a teacher instead of making real money?
Because some things are more important than money.
Mina! one of my colleagues has a course on The Vampire Nation-- I don't suppose I could put you two in touch?
Oh, so I can be a guest speaker or something like that?
Then stop embarassing your wife and buy a halfway decent jacket.
I know you seek to usurp Simon. Don't do it.

You don't really want to be Viscount. You want the power that comes with the title. So just wish for fame or money or some other thing that you think will give you a fabulous life with zero responsibility-- and don't disrupt the entire Barony of New York.
I'm assuming that's not a compliment.
Ah, I see. The joke is that I'm old. You're very clever Mina, truly the brightest mind of a generation.
I'm really not in the mood for the fashion critique.
When I was ten I was Corn Princess of the Macomb Harvest Festival.
So what do you want me call you-- Mina Ha? Or Rosita Lopez?
Worst fake ID I've ever seen in my life.
My bar is amazing and you're just pissed you're never going set foot in it.
Treat people nicer Mina. You'll go a lot farther.
I see we haven't grown as a person.
I'm no threat to your ambitions.
Luckily, no one's asking you to wear it.
Feel free to keep your distance.
Don't worry about me Mina. I believe we will work exceptionally well together.
I ruined your life? Mina, my father tried to kill me.
Go on, make it all about you.
You should have told me you were alive.
You didn't love me you loved my last name.
I don't know if that's true.
How awkward is this gonna be, Mina?

I don't know: how awkward is working with your fiance that you thought was dead but it just turns out they faked their death because they suck and hate the free market and anything that vaguely looks like responsibility?
Oh, I'm with the loser who got himself caught and executed. This should be fun.
You are so very lucky that I need your help for the next 40 minutes or so.
Presumably you're trying to summon the patron to make people forget about your last two collections.
Mina. I would rather wear my prison jumpsuit than that abomination you trotted out at fashion week.
You don't know what you're talking about.
I know how to take care of myself.
I'm talking about your career, not the ritual. Vampires by their nature are stagnant, and you have chosen to work in a medium that is ever evolving.
Your unfinished hem experiment was definitely not.
Listen old man, you try to stake me and I'll rip out your throat.
There's no need for threats, Mina. I know we're both confident that we can kill each other, let's just get through this like adults.
So... you want to be queen of the vampires.
I know what the title is, I was speaking colloquially.
I-- ugh. Mina. Can we please just get through this?
Fine. Just try not to suck.
So you're the big scary vampire hunter.
Because if you knew what a Venator was capable of you wouldn't be talking to me like a moron.
You can't speak to me like that.
Young lady I will speak to you however I damn well please. Now get it together and focus on the ritual.
I'm sure you're self-conscious about the whole corpse thing, but, I bet if you're in a dimly lit club you'd be a Midwest 8, New York 6.
Whoever stitched you up did a shit job.
You think you could do better?
Of course I could do better.
Didn't realize you were a doctor.
I'm not. I'm someone who actually knows how to sew.
Then fix me up after the ritual.
You walk one of my shows, then sure.
Why not, what else am I gonna do?
I don't hate working with you.
I think we're going to make a good team Vindicta.
Based on your reputation, I was expecting barbs, not compliments.
When you're a vampire you learn real quick to respect old people that talk weird.
Between the two of us, I'm not liking their chances.
Oh we're going to pick them apart and there's not a damn thing they can do about it.
Let's try this: give it to me or I'll stab you.
I know what happens next, I keep stabbing you until you're dead.
Anything would be more then, now wouldn't it
Us girls gotta stick together so if you ever need me to cut up a models face to send a message just let me know.
You're welome. Now that we're friends can I have 20 bucks.
I'm going to be Viscount in about 40 minutes.
Well, I'm looking forward to this being the beginning of our relationship.
I don't need a relationship with you.
No one needs a relationship with anybody, but I think we can help each other out.
I'm rich. You have nothing I want.
I mean, aside from connections with fashion editors, models, and anyone in the venn diagram of people with status who also have vices, sure. I got nothing.
I am so sorry. We should be friends.
If they get close, they'll regret it.
This should keep the rabble away.
Eh, they'll die, I'll live, it'll be fine.
I'm not worried about my health.
If I want their blood, I'll take it.
They're going to regret getting close to me.
I hope I don't bend my umbrella beating them to death.
Mom would say I'm lowering myself to their level, but... Whatever. She's not here.
I’m going to take my time with them!
I won't let you kill me!
So much better than taking the subway.
Good luck trying to stop me.
They can try to stop me, but it's not gonna go well for them.
Oh, I am going to be so annoying.
I can't wait to harass them!
I can't wait to fly around Manhattan!
Come on, come on, come on, come on!
I don't need to be up close to kill someone.
I'll be sure to spread the love.
When the end comes, there's nothing they can do about it.
They die, when I say they die.
I'm going to kill them all.
I'm coming for every one of them!
I have to be sure to spread this around.
I can’t wait for the grand finale!
I’d give up if I were you.
My bats will fill the air!
They're gonna be running like hell!
My bats will run them down.
Who's ready to see something amazing?
They have no idea what's in store for them.
The umbrella's not just for show!
You ready to stretch your wings, darlings?
I can't wait to hear their wings flutter!
This just keeps getting better and better!
The sky will be filled with crimson!
Looking forward to hearing them scream!
It starts slow, but boy, does it ramp up!
This is going to be spectacular!
I love hunting in the city!
You have no idea what I’m capable of!
You missed your chance to kill me!
No one stops me from getting what I want.
Great. Now I'm gonna have to get this dry-cleaned.
You really need to respect your betters.
I know how to deal with rich assholes!
I didn't forget what you did.
They were outmatched from the beginning.
You are all bearing witness to perfection.
Trust me. The longer this goes on, the worse it's gonna get for you!
No one stands between me and my destiny.
Think the vampire nation is taking note now?
Soon, the barony of New York will belong to me!
My power is only getting stronger! Give up and save us all some time.
I will sit on a throne of your broken bodies!
Not even the Viscount could stop me!
Ready to release the swarm again.
I don't care about their abilities.
Their magic is too weak to matter!
I need to improve my powers.
Can't forget to train my abilities!
I can get an item to help.
Might want to go to the Curiosity Shop.
The Shopkeeper is a little much for me, but... his wares are good!
I wonder what I can get now!
Might be time to swing by the store again.
The right item could tip the scales
I should see what else they're selling at the store.
I have enough souls to get something good.
You're going to suffer for this.
You'd think I'd let that happen?
I don't say no to free money.
We're closer to completing the ritual.
So they got some souls, who cares?
Why are you hiding? I was having fun!
The longer you hide, the worse it's gonna be for you.
Just come out and die and save us all some time.
Aww, but I was starting to have fun!
Look who's running home to cry!
I'll make them pay for this.
I don't like the way that was going.
I don't like being this exposed.
I'm on my own out here. I need to be careful.
It's okay. I'm used to high-pressure situations.
I'll hold on as long as I can!
Well. The help is all dead. That's awesome.
I don't know if I can take them all.
Might be time to back up.
We need to plan a defence!
Be careful! They got the Rejuv!
I can't let them finish this without me!
I need to get back out there!
And now we complete the ritual.
This is the beginning of the end.
Time to end things once and for all.
Like there was ever any doubt.
How else was this going to end?
No need to thank me, I know I'm amazing.
Some of you desperately need a fashion consultant.
Take a look at these losers! They don't have a chance in hell.
I have things to do, people, let's get this show on the road!
How hard can summoning a god be?
Like there was ever any doubt.
How else was this going to end?
We all played our parts to perfection.
Hm! You weren't dead weight after all!
I'd work with you all again.
No need to thank me, I know I'm amazing.
They're not able to stop Abrams!
Good luck doing... whatever a golem does.
Bebop, you're not useless after all!
Hope that doorman does something useful.
Did he notice me? Oh God, I think he noticed me...
We need to help the professor!
Maybe teachers aren't totally useless after all!
I was starting to get worried!
Looks like someone took their arthritis medication.
Not bad for an old man.
My God, Grey Talon, you're actually useful!
The old man was looking out for us!
Looks like Grey Talon wasn't taking a nap after all.
Hm! She makes that tie work.
Haze, you belong on the runway!
You need to help the sheriff!
We make a good team, Infernus!
You're fun to work with, Infernus!
That thing didn't have a chance!
No one can actually be that happy all the time.
You know, Ivy, at first I thought you were disgustingly saccharine. But now you're surprisingly useful!
That thing didn't have a chance!
Did she notice me? I think she noticed me.
Oh my God, I love her!
They gotta be hating Lash now!
I see why Fairfax keeps her around.
Now there goes a man who knows his place.
There goes a walking fashion crime.
I like the way you think, Paradox!
Stupid Arin, with their stupid scarf, and their stupid case, and their stupid family!
Okay, maybe Seven's scary after all.
Uh, that guy spends way too much time on his hair.
He just stopped a lot of people, didn't he?
At least he's hunting them, not me.
Someone get that lady some shoes.
What the hell is that thing?
Oh, this feels so good on my skin!
I take it all back, the Cube is amazing!
She's odious, but... She's good at killing people!
I can't understand a damn thing that lady says.
There's more to her than I thought.
Huh! She stabbed the hell out of them!
Don't think Abrams will underestimate me again.
Aww, I thought he was supposed to be tough.
Oh my God, this Ixian won't die!
Can you please just stand there and die?!
Help me kill this stupid detective!
You're not at my level, Apollo
I expected better of you, Apollo.
Hate to do that to a fellow Blackmore alumni.
What chance did an automaton have against me?
"Oh, I want to save Miss Shelly so she doesn't die!" Whatever.
Ugh, I hope I don't get rabies!
He was not a very nice person.
You're angry, we get it, get a hobby!
Bye, Billy. No one will miss you.
A shame, in another life you could have been my cool aunt or something.
I'd rather die than become a creepy cat lady.
Oh my God, I think that cat was their only friend. That is so sad.
If you had to have a cat, why'd you pick a sphynx?
She's weird, but she has a look about her.
God, I bet she tastes delicious.
I wanna feed on a unicorn so bad.
I bet her blood tastes like cotton candy and peppermint ice cream.
The tattoos are ugly as sin, but the hair is great.
The Doorman's dead. It was easy.
Of course they left it to me to kill the cosmic being.
Just so you know, the hat makes you look stupid.
Get that thing away from me!
Never seen a vampire like him before.
There's only room for one predator of the night.
Yeah, sure he was a vampire, but he was a shitty vampire, so it's okay.
Word of advice, Dynamo: burn the jacket.
I can only imagine having to sit through his lectures.
You are not very good at this, are you, professor?
The best their Patron could find was a college professor? Oh, man, they're screwed.
We don't need to be scared of the professor.
Look out for the black hole!
Be ready for a black hole.
Oh look, the weird little goth kid is playing with zombies, I'm shocked.
I wonder if her parents know that their daughter sucks so much.
I'm surprised that he didn't crumble to dust.
That was one angry old man.
Aww, you stumbled out of hospice just to die here.
Your grandkids are dead, I get it, go buy a dog!
His old man smell will haunt me.
Okay, so Sandmen are as scary as people say.
She was making that uniform work!
I'm not worried about the OSIC. Vampires are a protected species.
Haze, you may walk through dreams, but I own the night.
Where do you think you're going, Haze?
I love playing hide and seek!
Blah, blah, blah, Macomb Massacre, blah, blah.
Took care of the Midwest Hayseed!
Put me down, you goddamn redneck!
You should have stayed behind the bar where you belonged!
That's for carding me on my 16th birthday.
Your stupid little bar is gonna close and there is nothing you can do about it.
Being killed by me is probably the highlight of your miserable life.
Maybe next time you'll be good at your job, Infernus.
You were never going to pull that off, Infernus!
"I'm the savior of Spanish Harlem!" No, you're a dumb gargoyle and you're dead.
No one likes you, Ivy, they're just pretending.
Tell you what, Ivy, if you ask nicely, I'll let you carry my purse.
I thought that guy was supposed to be a big deal.
You make walking corpses look bad, Kelvin.
You know, Kelvin, maybe if you stopped underestimating people, your whole expedition wouldn't have died in the Arctic.
Well, that was a sad getaway.
I don't care that she tried to kill me. Lady Geist is amazing!
Now, hopefully I impressed her with my ruthlessness.
Well, that might have killed my chances of dressing her for the Met Gala.
I get why Sandra thinks he's hot.
I was expecting more from you, Lash.
I'm not some grubby pit fighter, Lash, I'm real talent!
Well, he wasn't lacking in confidence. Skill? Yes, but confidence? No.
I thought you were supposed to be competent, Lash!
Some genius she turned out to be.
If I cared about science, went to engineering school, and actually applied myself?.. I could have been you.
"I'm a genius!" Nah bitch, you're dead.
I don't get why people think she's a big deal.
I'll smash every one of her machines!
I'm gonna kill Fairfax's little pet genius!
We get it, you like the Djinn.
You'd think the ambassador would have a better personal assistant.
You don't have to yell everything, Jesus!
I'm pretty sure those were the guys selling knock-offs of my dresses.
Get your filthy paws off me!
Can someone shoot this goddamn mole?!
Arthur dies at the end. Yeah, I read it, don't act surprised.
She would have been eaten alive at Eastside.
Why couldn't she have brought Dickens or some other boring shit?
What was she gonna do? Chaucer me to death?
You know, there was a time when Paradox was actually relevant.
She thought she was so smart.
Hey! I killed the time thief.
That's the best you got, Paradox?
Thought she'd be harder to kill than that.
I should have been a Fairfax.
The only acceptable time for a pillow fight is a photoshoot, and even that's tacky.
He smelled like a dirty subway tunnel.
Oh, my God, would it kill you to put on some real pants? A shirt, jacket, anything?!
I think he was creepier than Espina...
I don't get why people are so scared of the world's tackiest lamp.
Seven's dead, no big deal. You're welcome!
Man, the Baxter Society must be falling on hard times if he's working for them.
Oh, a bad boy. How original.
He thought he was so cool, didn't he?
Ugh, get with the times, Shiv! Stabbing people was sooo three years ago.
Well she was a total bitch.
Magic tricks are stupid, and I'm glad you're dead.
I'm glad those two losers weren't on my team.
To think there was a time where the Sinclairs were actually relevant.
You think I was just gonna let you hunt me?
You're just a man, Rourke, and you're gonna die screaming like one.
I won't be hunted by the likes of you!
He'll model for me one day.
He looked so sad... Oh well, who cares?
I hate killing a man who can pull off leather pants.
So, now that you know you're gonna lose, do you think your name's ironic or just tragic?
What lame costume party did she walk out of?
You tried to assassinate me? Who'd I look like, Arin Fairfax?
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Vindicta.
You thought you were safe in the skies?
I can get to you whenever I want, Vindicta!
Oh my god... He was made of goo.
He's like if salt water taffy grew arms and legs.
That goo better not stain my jacket!
Oh, my God, you are the most disgusting woman I've ever met.
I cannot kill that woman fast enough.
I loathe everything about you, Vyper.
I hate your stupid face, I hate your stupid attitude, and I hate your stupid Midwest accent!
I've seen Vampire Elders with a smaller stick up their ass.
That guy's gotta work through some mommy and daddy issues.
Yeah, I don't get why people are scared of him.
Uh, course I killed Warden! I'm me.
Yeah, she has money, but it's new money, so it's like... Eh.
Credit where credit is due: her hat was pretty great.
You shouldn't try to rise above your station, Wraith.
Some queen bee she turned out to be.
Looks like she was all hype.
Who would have guessed the woman swinging an antique didn't survive?
Yamato's dead, which isn't surprising, cuz she was fighting me.
I don't get why people are scared of her.
You lost, Yamato. Deal with it!
They took out the bloodsucking kid!
They took out that pathetic excuse for a vampire!
You're never going to be Viscount, Mina.
You’re not feeding off of me, Mina.
You always had too high of an opinion of yourself, Mina.
You're not half as good as you think you are, Mina.
No love for your alma mater, Mina?
There's always someone better than you, Mina!
A little humility would do her wonders.
Mina, you weren't ready to face someone like me.
I'm not scared of some undead brat!
Not feelin' so cocky now, are ya, Mina?
My bat's better than your bat.
I hope your new clothing line gets panned.
You're not a very nice person, Mina.
The way you treat people is ugly, Mina.
Just once I'd like to meet a vampire that isn't a jerk.
Love your dress, by the way.
I can't believe she thinks that she can be Viscount!
Vampires and their delusions of grandeur...

Mina, Mina, Mina. Your future was stolen from you by an assassin’s bullet and replaced with the promise of eternal youth. We both know how well that’s turned out for you. You’re a child, just learning to play a game that others have spent hundreds of years perfecting. You are destined to fail.
You’re a nobody, Mina. You don’t have a chance at becoming viscount.
Kid like you is never gonna be Viscount.
The Vampire Nation is a Ponzi scheme, Mina! The sooner you realize that, the better.
I see that sorry excuse for a vampire.
Mina, you don’t know as much as you think you do.
That young lady is casually cruel.
You won life, Mina, can you stop being an asshole?
Oh, the misplaced arrogance of youth.
Young vampires are always the stupidest.
You have a lot to learn, Mina.
Looks like the viscount is going to owe us some favours.
You're not in charge, Mina, we are.
How about you go cry about it to mommy and daddy?
You got a lotta growin' up to do, Mina.
Hopefully she'll mellow out as she gets older.
No point talkin' sense to her. She wouldn't listen anyway.
Mommy and daddy can buy you a vampire, but they can't buy you common sense.
Mina, you don't have to be so nasty to everyone!
Hope Sophia doesn't end up like her.
Vampires are a lot more fun when you're reading about them, and they're not trying to kill you.
You have much to learn, Mina.
Maybe you're not as invincible as you think you are, Mina.
She is precarious, to put it mildly.
You need to pick better friends, Mina.
You're surrounding yourself with deplorable people, Mina.
She has my ambition... But not my talent, I'm afraid.
I get it, I'd wanna drink my blood too
A vampire with my blood running through its veins? Good god, they'd be unstoppable.
You get the message, Mina? You're not better than The Lash.
God, vampires are such a pain in the ass.
Too bad mommy and daddy can't buy you a win.
Mina, your childish antics won't stop me.
One day you'll grow up and realize your folly.
You won't feed on me today, vampire.
Personally, I find her fashion line to be overwrought, but, ah, who am I to judge?
She was a cruel little girl...
Why are you so mean to people?
I think she has self-esteem issues.
Glad I didn't end up like her.
Mina, you're not special because your Mummy and Daddy paid for someone to turn you into a vampire.
She probably had more clout before she was turned.
I don't think I like people with pointy teeth.
I wanna play with the umbrella...
You know nothing of real power, Mina.
It's adorable that you thought you could stop me.
Little lady, when it comes to vampires you don't crack the top 50.
Mina you're crazy if you think you can replace Simon Pardoner as viscount.
Few things more annoying than a vampire with an ego.
I know scary vampires. You, Mina, you ain't scary.
Teenagers are bad enough before you turn 'em immortal...
Welcome to the real world, kid.
I'm tired of people like you lookin' down on me.
Mina, you needed a little dose of reality.
You're not special, Mina. You're just a brat.
You're not better than anyone, Mina.
You won't be feedin' on my friends, Mina.
Maybe Mina will have a little more humility.
Someone had to shut her up.
Mina? You're not in charge here.
I can't stand people like her.
Silly Mina, I don't have blood, I have goo!
I don't need to drink blood, I have the Cube.
We don't need to worry about the vampire anymore.
She was dead, but now she's deader.
Man, you crash Fashion Week one time and the next thing you know the lady plots your death.
Oh, I'd love to see her spend two weeks in Rikers. It'd be a hoot!
身のほどを知るがいい。
You had the world at your fingertips, and it was stolen from you by an assassin's bullet... but it's not too late to change your future. Complete the ritual.
The Vampire Nation will never make someone like you Viscount of New York, but if you summon the Hidden King... he can get you the title you seek.
The other vampires are old. Weak. Not in power, but in spirit. In vision... but not you. You have the chance to lead the barony of New York to new heights! But first, you must complete the ritual.
You may not be a Fairfax, but you are something greater. You are Mina Ha! The woman who heralds the Hidden King's arrival to this plane!
Once you complete the ritual, Arin will realize their folly, and the other vampires... your worth.
Mina Ha, rise up and take what you deserve!
Mina darts amongst them, a perpetual thorn in their side!
Oh, how Mina's crimson children make them scream!
Mina offers barbs to our enemies, and salvation to our allies!
